title: Russian Missiles Kill 9 in Kyiv, Hours After Trump Backs Off Air Defense Pledge
summary_full: It was the second deadly barrage to hit the Ukrainian capital in two days, as Moscow escalates its attacks in an apparent effort to exploit Ukraine’s dwindling supply of interceptors.
